+### Banner browser check
+
+The banner check imports synthetic artwork and creates Bots on a **fresh disposable installation only**. Start a separate installation and use its one-time setup code:
+
+```powershell
+Set-Location frontend
+npm ci
+npx playwright install chromium
+$env:E2E_URL = "http://localhost:3000"
+$env:E2E_SETUP_TOKEN = "your-disposable-setup-code"
+npm run test:banner
+```
+
+### Budget browser check
+
+The budget check imports synthetic artwork and creates a Bot, and deliberately checks that a zero account cap refuses a message before it reaches a gateway. Use a **fresh disposable installation only**:

+npx playwright install chromium
+$env:E2E_URL = "http://localhost:3000"
+$env:E2E_SETUP_TOKEN = "your-disposable-setup-code"

 ## Current behavior and limitations
 
-**No spending caps are implemented yet.** Funk Bot cannot prevent a runaway run from consuming gateway credits. Set limits with your provider and do not leave the app unattended.
+**Budget safeguards are not a guarantee of provider billing.** Funk Bot reserves against account and per-Bot daily/monthly caps before chat requests, but it depends on accurate configured prices, a conservative input-token bound, and the gateway honoring output limits and reporting usage. Tokenization overhead, gateway-added charges, incorrect prices, providers that ignore limits, and spending outside Funk Bot can exceed these estimates. Always set provider-side limits and do not leave runs unattended.
+
+Open **Settings → Budget** to set caps and profile prices. The account and each Bot default to $5/day; monthly limits are disabled until configured. Periods use UTC. Each model round, including a follow-up after a tool call, reserves for every possible fallback; no configured price means the run is refused. Costs for new runs are calculated from reported input/output tokens and the profile's configured prices, not inferred from a model name. If an attempt fails, is interrupted, exceeds configured token bounds, or does not report usage, further spending is blocked until you verify its total in your gateway billing and enter the charge and source in Budget. These owner-supplied corrections are audited. Old usage without a cost must likewise be reconciled when it falls within a capped period. Existing Bots, keys, sprites and messages are not deleted by the budget migrations.
 
 - Each Bot has its own stored timeline and identity. The last 40 messages are sent as context; this is conversation history, not semantic memory. Deleting a Bot deletes its messages.
 - The database uses SQLAlchemy connections with Alembic migrations, adopting existing slice databases without replacing their rows. SQL queries and migrations remain SQLite-specific; PostgreSQL support is not implemented. Back up the full data volume before upgrading.
 - Chat runs in the backend and can finish after the browser closes, provided the backend keeps running. Run records and streamed events are stored in SQLite. Reopening a Bot reconnects to an active run; after a backend restart, unfinished runs are marked failed and surfaced in that Bot’s chat rather than automatically resumed. Run the backend with one worker only. Provider text streams through a sliding-window redactor for saved gateway keys and common key patterns. The filter deliberately delays a small tail of text and cannot detect all possible secrets.
-- Profiles attempt entries in order for rate limits, server failures, connection errors, and empty responses. Client errors stop the chain. The app does not yet implement tool calling or tool-call fallback.
-- Costs and token totals are shown only when gateways report them. No hard budget cap is enforced.
+- Profiles attempt entries in order for rate limits, server failures, connection errors, and empty responses. Client errors and partially emitted responses stop the chain. The gateway and selected model must support OpenAI-compatible streamed tool calls. If a prior attempt may have incurred an unknown charge, no tools are executed and the charge must be reconciled before more spending.
+- Bots can request `web_fetch` and `write_note`; there is no shell tool. Web access is default-deny; configure exact hosts or domain suffixes in **Settings → Web access**. Deny rules override allow rules, every resolved address must be public, connections use the validated address, redirects/compression are refused, and requests are limited to 256 KiB and 10 seconds. Web pages remain untrusted and can contain misleading or malicious instructions; these safeguards are not a complete defense against prompt injection.
+- `write_note` creates a new `.txt` file only within the individual Bot's workspace. The owner sees the redacted arguments that will actually execute and must choose **Approve once**, **Approve for this response** (same tool only, current run only), or **Deny**. Review the entire content before approving. Tool activity appears in chat and **Settings → Tool audit**. A pending approval can be stopped; an interrupted or restarted run is never replayed automatically. A completed tool action is not undone if a subsequent model round exceeds a cap or fails. Deleting a Bot deletes its tool audit and conversation, but leaves its workspace note files on disk and returns its sprite to the Vault. Redaction is heuristic, not a guarantee that secrets are removed.
+- Token totals come from reported usage. Known costs include configured-price token charges and owner-reconciled amounts; unknown charges are disclosed rather than treated as free. Caps are reservation-based estimates, not provider-enforced billing limits.
 - Vault encryption protects database contents from casual inspection, but its key is stored alongside the data on the same host. Protect filesystem access and backups. Messages and provider output are redacted for saved gateway keys and common key patterns; no redaction is perfect.
-- The authenticated `/api/events?since=0` endpoint exposes cursor-ordered run starts, message summaries, state changes, errors, and finishes recorded after this upgrade. Existing slice-2 events remain in per-run history and are not backfilled. Deleting a Bot deletes its event history. This is not a complete audit log. No search, file access, MCP, scheduler, webhook, sandbox, approvals, notifications, PWA, export, or browser/computer features are provided in this slice. The UI intentionally does not advertise those as working.
+- The authenticated `/api/events?since=0` endpoint exposes cursor-ordered run starts, message summaries, state changes, errors, and finishes recorded after this upgrade. Existing slice-2 events remain in per-run history and are not backfilled. Deleting a Bot deletes its event history. This is not a complete audit log.  - Provider names and defaults are configuration examples, not a guarantee that models are currently available. A working account/key and gateway configuration are required for live inference.

+@app.get('/api/budget')
+def get_budget(request: Request):
+    require_auth(request)
+    with db() as c:
+        account = limits_for(c, 'account')
+        bots = {row['scope'][4:]: {'daily': nano_string(row['daily_nanos']), 'monthly': None if row['monthly_nanos'] is None else nano_string(row['monthly_nanos'])} for row in c.execute("SELECT * FROM budget_limits WHERE scope LIKE 'bot:%'")}
+        prices = {row['profile']: {'prompt': row['prompt_usd_per_million'], 'completion': row['completion_usd_per_million'], 'max_prompt_tokens': row['max_prompt_tokens'], 'max_completion_tokens': row['max_completion_tokens']} for row in c.execute('SELECT * FROM budget_prices')}
+        uncertain = [dict(row) for row in c.execute("SELECT run_id,bot_id,profile,created_at FROM budget_reservations WHERE status='uncertain' ORDER BY created_at DESC")]
+        unknown = [dict(row) for row in c.execute("SELECT id,bot_id,gateway,model,created_at FROM usage WHERE cost IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM budget_reservations WHERE budget_reservations.usage_id=usage.id) ORDER BY created_at DESC")]
+    keys=configured_secrets()
+    for row in unknown:
+        for field in ('gateway','model'):
+            if row[field] is not None: row[field]=redact_text(row[field],keys)
+    return {'account': {'daily': nano_string(account[0]), 'monthly': None if account[1] is None else nano_string(account[1])}, 'bots': bots, 'prices': prices, 'unreconciled': uncertain, 'unknown_usage': unknown}

+@app.put('/api/budget/limits/{scope}')
+def put_budget_limits(scope: str, body: BudgetLimitsIn, request: Request):
+    require_auth(request)
+    if scope != 'account' and not scope.startswith('bot:'): raise HTTPException(400, 'Invalid budget scope.')
+    try:
+        daily = limit_to_nanos(body.daily)
+        monthly = None if body.monthly is None else limit_to_nanos(body.monthly)
+    except BudgetError as exc: raise HTTPException(400, str(exc)) from exc
+    with db() as c:
+        c.execute('BEGIN IMMEDIATE')
+        if scope.startswith('bot:') and not c.execute('SELECT 1 FROM bots WHERE id=?', (scope[4:],)).fetchone(): raise HTTPException(404, 'Bot not found.')
+        c.execute('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO budget_limits VALUES (?,?,?)', (scope,daily,monthly))
+    return {'ok': True}
+
+
+@app.put('/api/budget/prices/{profile}')
+def put_budget_price(profile: str, body: BudgetPriceIn, request: Request):
+    require_auth(request)
+    if profile not in PROFILES: raise HTTPException(404, 'Profile not found.')
+    try:
+        token_cost_nanos(body.max_prompt_tokens,body.max_completion_tokens,body.prompt,body.completion)
+    except BudgetError as exc: raise HTTPException(400,str(exc)) from exc
+    with db() as c:
+        c.execute('BEGIN IMMEDIATE')
+        c.execute('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO budget_prices VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)', (profile,body.prompt,body.completion,body.max_prompt_tokens,body.max_completion_tokens))
+    return {'ok': True}
+

+@app.post('/api/budget/reconcile/{kind}/{identifier}')
+def reconcile_budget(kind: str, identifier: str, body: BudgetCorrectionIn, request: Request):
+    require_auth(request)
+    source = redact(body.source)
+    try:
+        with db() as c:
+            c.execute('BEGIN IMMEDIATE')
+            if kind == 'run': reconcile_run(c,identifier,body.amount,source)
+            elif kind == 'usage' and identifier.isdigit(): reconcile_usage(c,int(identifier),body.amount,source)
+            else: raise HTTPException(400, 'Invalid correction target.')
+    except BudgetError as exc: raise HTTPException(400, str(exc)) from exc
+    return {'ok': True}

+def settle_round(c, job, bot_id, gateway, model, usage):
+    """Record one model round and return a warning when its charge is unknown."""
+    reservation_id=job.get('round_id',job['id'])
+    prompt_tokens,completion_tokens=usage.get('prompt_tokens'),usage.get('completion_tokens')
+    if type(prompt_tokens) is int and type(completion_tokens) is int and prompt_tokens >= 0 and completion_tokens >= 0:
+        c.execute('INSERT INTO usage (bot_id,gateway,model,prompt_tokens,completion_tokens,cost,created_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)', (bot_id,gateway,model,prompt_tokens,completion_tokens,None,time.time()))
+        usage_id=c.execute('SELECT last_insert_rowid()').fetchone()[0]
+        cost=None if job.get('uncertain') else settle(c,reservation_id,usage_id,prompt_tokens,completion_tokens)
+        if cost is not None: return None
+        c.execute("UPDATE budget_reservations SET status='uncertain',usage_id=? WHERE run_id=? AND status IN ('reserved','uncertain')",(usage_id,reservation_id))
+        return 'Gateway charges could not be verified. Further spending is blocked pending reconciliation.'
+    c.execute("UPDATE budget_reservations SET status='uncertain' WHERE run_id=? AND status='reserved'",(reservation_id,))
+    return 'Gateway did not report token usage. Further spending is blocked pending reconciliation.'

+    # not a tokenizer or provider billing guarantee.
+    return len(json.dumps({'messages':messages,'tools':tool_definitions},ensure_ascii=True).encode('utf-8')) + 1024 + 128*len(messages)

+"""In-memory decision rendezvous for live tool calls.
+
+Durable decision auditing is handled separately by tool_audit. A process
+restart cancels the run; it must never re-execute an unresolved write.
+"""
+import asyncio
+from .tools import ToolError
+
+
+class ApprovalBroker:
+    def __init__(self): self.pending={}
+
+    def prepare(self, call_id):
+        if call_id in self.pending: raise ToolError('Approval is already pending.')
+        self.pending[call_id]=asyncio.get_running_loop().create_future()
+
+    def submit(self, call_id, decision):
+        if decision not in ('approve','approve_once','deny'): raise ToolError('Invalid approval decision.')
+        future=self.pending.get(call_id)
+        if not future or future.done(): raise ToolError('This approval is no longer pending.')
+        future.set_result(decision)
+
+    async def wait(self, call_id):
+        future=self.pending.get(call_id)
+        if not future: raise ToolError('This approval is no longer pending.')
+        try: return await future
+        finally: self.pending.pop(call_id,None)
+
+    def discard(self, call_id):
+        future=self.pending.pop(call_id,None)
+        if future and not future.done(): future.cancel()
+
+    def cancel_all(self):
+        for future in self.pending.values():
+            if not future.done(): future.cancel()
+        self.pending.clear()

+"""Conservative, transaction-friendly budget accounting primitives.
+
+No model request is authorized by this module on its own. The caller must
+hold an SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction around reservation and use an
+explicit gateway token bound. Prices are configured, never inferred.
+"""
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation, ROUND_CEILING, ROUND_FLOOR
+import time
+import uuid
+
+NANOS_PER_DOLLAR = 1_000_000_000
+DEFAULT_DAILY = 5 * NANOS_PER_DOLLAR
+MAX_DOLLARS = Decimal('1000000')
+
+
+class BudgetError(ValueError):
+    pass
+
+
+def dollars_to_nanos(value):
+    try:
+        amount = Decimal(str(value))
+        if not amount.is_finite() or amount < 0 or amount > MAX_DOLLARS:
+            raise BudgetError('Dollar amounts must be between 0 and 1,000,000.')
+        return int((amount * NANOS_PER_DOLLAR).to_integral_value(rounding=ROUND_CEILING))
+    except (InvalidOperation, TypeError) as exc:
+        raise BudgetError('Enter a valid dollar amount.') from exc
+
+
+def limit_to_nanos(value):
+    # A ceiling must never round upward and authorize more than the owner set.
+    dollars_to_nanos(value)  # validate range and finiteness first
+    return int((Decimal(str(value)) * NANOS_PER_DOLLAR).to_integral_value(rounding=ROUND_FLOOR))
+
+
+def token_cost_nanos(prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, prompt_price, completion_price):
+    if type(prompt_tokens) is not int or type(completion_tokens) is not int or min(prompt_tokens, completion_tokens) < 0:
+        raise BudgetError('Gateway token usage is missing or invalid.')
+    # Per-million price * tokens * 1000 produces nanodollars.
+    try:
+        p, q = Decimal(str(prompt_price)), Decimal(str(completion_price))
+        if not p.is_finite() or not q.is_finite() or min(p, q) < 0 or max(p, q) > MAX_DOLLARS:
+            raise BudgetError('Model prices must be between 0 and 1,000,000 USD per million tokens.')
+        amount = (p * prompt_tokens + q * completion_tokens) * 1000
+        if amount > 9_000_000_000_000_000_000:
+            raise BudgetError('Calculated cost is too large.')
+        return int(amount.to_integral_value(rounding=ROUND_CEILING))
+    except (InvalidOperation, TypeError) as exc:
+        raise BudgetError('Enter valid model prices.') from exc
+
+
+def period_starts(now):
+    # Shared, deterministic boundaries independent of server locale or DST.
+    date = datetime.fromtimestamp(now, timezone.utc)
+    return (date.replace(hour=0, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0).timestamp(),
+            date.replace(day=1, hour=0, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0).timestamp())
+
+
+def limits_for(c, scope):
+    row = c.execute('SELECT daily_nanos,monthly_nanos FROM budget_limits WHERE scope=?', (scope,)).fetchone()
+    return (row['daily_nanos'], row['monthly_nanos']) if row else (DEFAULT_DAILY, None)
+
+
+def reserve(c, run_id, bot_id, profile, now, attempts=1, parent_run_id=None):
+    """Reserve the configured maximum. Caller holds BEGIN IMMEDIATE.
+
+    Existing historical usage is included once; missing historical costs or an
+    uncertain run fail closed rather than silently pretending they cost zero.
+    """
+    price = c.execute('SELECT * FROM budget_prices WHERE profile=?', (profile,)).fetchone()
+    if not price:
+        raise BudgetError(f'Configure prices and token limits for the {profile} profile before running.')
+    if type(attempts) is not int or not 1 <= attempts <= 10:
+        raise BudgetError('A profile must contain one to ten models.')
+    maximum = token_cost_nanos(price['max_prompt_tokens'], price['max_completion_tokens'], price['prompt_usd_per_million'], price['completion_usd_per_million']) * attempts
+    if maximum > 9_000_000_000_000_000_000:
+        raise BudgetError('Calculated reservation is too large.')
+    day, month = period_starts(now)
+    for scope, bot_filter in [('account', None), ('bot:' + bot_id, bot_id)]:
+        daily, monthly = limits_for(c, scope)
+        for start, cap, period in [(day, daily, 'daily'), (month, monthly, 'monthly')]:
+            if cap is None:
+                continue
+            condition = ' AND bot_id=?' if bot_filter else ''
+            params = (start, now, bot_filter) if bot_filter else (start, now)
+            old = c.execute('''SELECT cost FROM usage WHERE created_at>=? AND created_at<=?''' + condition +
+                ' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM budget_reservations WHERE budget_reservations.usage_id=usage.id)', params).fetchall()
+            if any(row['cost'] is None for row in old):
+                raise BudgetError(f'{scope} has historical usage without a cost in this {period} period; spending cannot be verified.')
+            spent = sum(dollars_to_nanos(row['cost']) for row in old)
+            # Outstanding commitments can cross UTC midnight/month-end; count
+            # them in every current period until reconciled, never just by start.
+            reservation_params = (start, now, bot_filter) if bot_filter else (start, now)
+            reservations = c.execute("SELECT * FROM budget_reservations WHERE (status IN ('reserved','uncertain') OR (status='settled' AND settled_at>=? AND settled_at<=?))" + condition, reservation_params).fetchall()
+            if any(row['status'] == 'uncertain' for row in reservations):
+                raise BudgetError(f'{scope} has an unreconciled run in this {period} period; spending cannot be verified.')
+            spent += sum(row['actual_nanos'] if row['status'] == 'settled' else row['reserved_nanos'] for row in reservations)
+            if spent + maximum > cap:
+                raise BudgetError(f'{scope} {period} budget cap would be exceeded by the configured reservation for this run.')
+    c.execute('''INSERT INTO budget_reservations
+        (run_id,bot_id,profile,created_at,reserved_nanos,prompt_usd_per_million,completion_usd_per_million,max_prompt_tokens,max_completion_tokens,status,parent_run_id)
+        VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,'reserved',?)''', (run_id,bot_id,profile,now,maximum,price['prompt_usd_per_million'],price['completion_usd_per_million'],price['max_prompt_tokens'],price['max_completion_tokens'],parent_run_id or run_id))
+    return maximum
+
+
+def settle(c, run_id, usage_id, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, now=None):
+    row = c.execute('SELECT * FROM budget_reservations WHERE run_id=?', (run_id,)).fetchone()
+    if not row or row['status'] != 'reserved':
+        raise BudgetError('Reservation is not active.')
+    try:
+        if prompt_tokens > row['max_prompt_tokens'] or completion_tokens > row['max_completion_tokens']:
+            raise BudgetError('Gateway exceeded the configured token limit.')
+        cost = token_cost_nanos(prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, row['prompt_usd_per_million'], row['completion_usd_per_million'])
+        usage = c.execute('SELECT bot_id,prompt_tokens,completion_tokens FROM usage WHERE id=?', (usage_id,)).fetchone()
+        if not usage or usage['bot_id'] != row['bot_id'] or usage['prompt_tokens'] != prompt_tokens or usage['completion_tokens'] != completion_tokens:
+            raise BudgetError('Usage record does not match the reservation.')
+    except (BudgetError, TypeError):
+        c.execute("UPDATE budget_reservations SET status='uncertain' WHERE run_id=?", (run_id,))
+        return None
+    c.execute("UPDATE usage SET cost=? WHERE id=?", (cost / NANOS_PER_DOLLAR, usage_id))
+    c.execute("UPDATE budget_reservations SET status='settled',actual_nanos=?,usage_id=?,settled_at=? WHERE run_id=?", (cost, usage_id, time.time() if now is None else now, run_id))
+    return cost
+
+
+def reconcile_run(c, run_id, amount, note, now=None):
+    """Record an owner's externally verified charge; caller holds a write lock.
+
+    A correction is not represented as reported token usage. Its audit record
+    makes clear that this amount was supplied by the owner, not the gateway.
+    """
+    row = c.execute('SELECT * FROM budget_reservations WHERE run_id=?', (run_id,)).fetchone()
+    if not row or row['status'] != 'uncertain':
+        raise BudgetError('Only an unreconciled run can be corrected.')
+    clean_note = note.strip() if isinstance(note, str) else ''
+    if not clean_note or len(clean_note) > 500:
+        raise BudgetError('Provide a short source for the verified charge.')
+    cost = dollars_to_nanos(amount)
+    timestamp = time.time() if now is None else now
+    c.execute('INSERT INTO budget_reconciliations (run_id,cost_nanos,note,created_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?)', (run_id,cost,clean_note,timestamp))
+    c.execute("UPDATE budget_reservations SET status='settled', actual_nanos=?, settled_at=? WHERE run_id=?", (cost,timestamp,run_id))
+    return cost
+
+
+def reconcile_usage(c, usage_id, amount, note, now=None):
+    """Record an owner's externally verified historical charge."""
+    row = c.execute('SELECT cost FROM usage WHERE id=?', (usage_id,)).fetchone()
+    if not row or row['cost'] is not None:
+        raise BudgetError('Only historical usage without a cost can be corrected.')
+    clean_note = note.strip() if isinstance(note, str) else ''
+    if not clean_note or len(clean_note) > 500:
+        raise BudgetError('Provide a short source for the verified charge.')
+    cost = dollars_to_nanos(amount)
+    timestamp = time.time() if now is None else now
+    c.execute('INSERT INTO budget_reconciliations (usage_id,cost_nanos,note,created_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?)', (usage_id,cost,clean_note,timestamp))
+    c.execute('UPDATE usage SET cost=? WHERE id=?', (cost / NANOS_PER_DOLLAR, usage_id))
+    return cost
+
+
+def reserve_followup(c, parent_run_id, bot_id, profile, now, attempts=1):
+    """Reserve a separate model round; caller holds BEGIN IMMEDIATE.
+
+    An earlier unresolved round blocks follow-ups even when the current cap
+    would otherwise allow them. No model request is made by this function.
+    """
+    run=c.execute('SELECT bot_id,status FROM runs WHERE id=?',(parent_run_id,)).fetchone()
+    if not run or run['bot_id'] != bot_id or run['status'] not in ('running','waiting_approval'):
+        raise BudgetError('The Bot run is no longer active.')
+    prior=c.execute('SELECT profile,status FROM budget_reservations WHERE parent_run_id=?', (parent_run_id,)).fetchall()
+    if not prior: raise BudgetError('The run has no prior budget reservation.')
+    if any(row['profile'] != profile for row in prior): raise BudgetError('A follow-up must use the original run profile.')
+    if any(row['status'] in ('reserved','uncertain') for row in prior):
+        raise BudgetError('The previous model request has not been reconciled.')
+    request_id=str(uuid.uuid4())
+    amount=reserve(c,request_id,bot_id,profile,now,attempts=attempts,parent_run_id=parent_run_id)
+    return request_id,amount

+"""Transactional audit/state primitives; never execute a tool from this module."""
+import json
+import time
+import uuid
+from pydantic import ValidationError
+from .tools import REGISTRY, ToolError
+
+
+def audit(c, call_id, action, now):
+    c.execute('INSERT INTO tool_audit (call_id,action,created_at) VALUES (?,?,?)', (call_id,action,now))
+
+
+def propose(c, run_id, bot_id, name, arguments, redact, now=None):
+    """Validate and redact before persistence; caller owns a write transaction."""
+    spec=REGISTRY.get(name)
+    if not spec: raise ToolError('Unknown tool.')
+    try:
+        parsed=spec.args.model_validate(arguments).model_dump()
+    except ValidationError as exc:
+        raise ToolError('Invalid tool arguments.') from exc
+    # The exact redacted arguments are both approved and later executed; never
+    # show a sanitized card while executing different hidden arguments.
+    cleaned={key:redact(value) if isinstance(value,str) else value for key,value in parsed.items()}
+    try:
+        cleaned=spec.args.model_validate(cleaned).model_dump()
+    except ValidationError as exc:
+        raise ToolError('Redacted tool arguments are invalid.') from exc
+    call_id=str(uuid.uuid4());now=time.time() if now is None else now
+    status='approved' if spec.risk=='read' else 'pending'
+    c.execute('''INSERT INTO tool_calls (id,run_id,bot_id,tool_name,risk,arguments,status,created_at,updated_at)
+                 VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)''', (call_id,run_id,bot_id,name,spec.risk,json.dumps(cleaned),status,now,now))
+    audit(c,call_id,'proposed',now)
+    if status=='approved': audit(c,call_id,'read_auto_approved',now)
+    return call_id
+
+
+def decide(c, call_id, decision, now=None):
+    if decision not in ('approve','approve_once','deny'): raise ToolError('Invalid approval decision.')
+    row=c.execute('SELECT risk,status FROM tool_calls WHERE id=?', (call_id,)).fetchone()
+    if not row or row['risk'] not in ('write','send','spend') or row['status']!='pending': raise ToolError('This approval is no longer pending.')
+    now=time.time() if now is None else now
+    status='denied' if decision=='deny' else 'approved'
+    c.execute('UPDATE tool_calls SET status=?,updated_at=? WHERE id=?', (status,now,call_id))
+    audit(c,call_id,decision,now)
+    return status
+
+
+def claim(c, call_id, now=None):
+    now=time.time() if now is None else now
+    result=c.execute("UPDATE tool_calls SET status='running',updated_at=? WHERE id=? AND status='approved'", (now,call_id))
+    if not result.rowcount: raise ToolError('Tool call is not approved or has already started.')
+    audit(c,call_id,'started',now)
+    return dict(c.execute('SELECT * FROM tool_calls WHERE id=?', (call_id,)).fetchone())
+
+
+def _redact_result(value, redact):
+    if isinstance(value, str): return redact(value)
+    if isinstance(value, list): return [_redact_result(item, redact) for item in value]
+    if isinstance(value, dict): return {redact(str(key)): _redact_result(item, redact) for key,item in value.items()}
+    return value
+
+
+def finish(c, call_id, result, success, redact, now=None):
+    now=time.time() if now is None else now
+    status='completed' if success else 'failed'
+    changed=c.execute("UPDATE tool_calls SET status=?,result=?,updated_at=? WHERE id=? AND status='running'", (status,json.dumps(_redact_result(result,redact)),now,call_id))
+    if not changed.rowcount: raise ToolError('Tool call is not running.')
+    audit(c,call_id,status,now)
+
+
+def approve_from_run_grant(c, call_id, now=None):
+    """Use a grant that exists only for the current, live run."""
+    now=time.time() if now is None else now
+    changed=c.execute("UPDATE tool_calls SET status='approved',updated_at=? WHERE id=? AND risk IN ('write','send','spend') AND status='pending'", (now,call_id))
+    if not changed.rowcount: raise ToolError('This approval is no longer pending.')
+    audit(c,call_id,'run_grant',now)
+
+
+def abort(c, call_id, reason, redact, now=None):
+    """Mark interruption without misrepresenting it as an owner denial."""
+    now=time.time() if now is None else now
+    changed=c.execute("UPDATE tool_calls SET status='failed',result=?,updated_at=? WHERE id=? AND status IN ('pending','approved','running')", (json.dumps({'error':redact(reason)}),now,call_id))
+    if changed.rowcount: audit(c,call_id,'interrupted',now)

+"""Connect an audited tool runtime to a live run's approval events.
+
+The host application supplies the event sink and owns the run lifecycle.
+"""
+from .approval_broker import ApprovalBroker
+from .tool_runtime import execute
+
+
+class ToolBridge:
+    def __init__(self, context, emit):
+        self.context=context
+        self.emit=emit
+        self.broker=ApprovalBroker()
+        self.context.notify=self.notify
+
+    def notify(self, event):
+        # Register before sending the card, so an immediate response cannot race
+        # the server's approval waiter. A run grant needs no second decision.
+        if event['type']=='tool.proposed' and event['status']=='pending' and event['tool'] not in self.context.run_grants:
+            self.broker.prepare(event['call_id'])
+        try: self.emit(event)
+        except Exception:
+            if event['type']=='tool.proposed': self.broker.discard(event['call_id'])
+            raise
+
+    async def execute(self, name, arguments):
+        return await execute(self.context,name,arguments,self.broker.wait)
+
+    def submit(self, call_id, decision):
+        self.broker.submit(call_id,decision)
+
+    def cancel(self):
+        self.broker.cancel_all()

+"""Web fetch host policy, defaulting to no allowed external sites."""
+import ipaddress
+import re
+from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, field_validator
+from .tools import canonical_host, public_address
+
+
+class WebPolicy(BaseModel):
+    model_config=ConfigDict(extra='forbid')
+    allow: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list,max_length=100)
+    deny: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list,max_length=100)
+
+    @field_validator('allow','deny')
+    @classmethod
+    def validate_hosts(cls, values):
+        cleaned=[]
+        for value in values:
+            if len(value)>254 or not value or value != value.strip() or '*' in value:
+                raise ValueError('Enter exact hostnames or .example.com suffixes; no wildcards, paths or ports.')
+            suffix=value.startswith('.')
+            host=canonical_host(value[1:] if suffix else value)
+            try:
+                ip=ipaddress.ip_address(host)
+            except ValueError:
+                labels=host.split('.')
+                if len(labels)<2 or any(not re.fullmatch(r'[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?',label) for label in labels):
+                    raise ValueError('Enter valid hostnames without paths or ports.')
+            else:
+                if suffix or not public_address(ip):
+                    raise ValueError('Private and non-public IP addresses cannot be listed.')
+                host=str(ip)
+            entry=('.' if suffix else '')+host
+            if entry not in cleaned: cleaned.append(entry)
+        return cleaned

+"""OpenAI-compatible tool declaration and streamed-call parsing.
+
+This module only parses data. It does not execute tools or authorize writes.
+"""
+import json
+import re
+from .tools import REGISTRY, ToolError
+from pydantic import ValidationError
+
+MAX_CALLS=6
+MAX_ARGUMENT_BYTES=20_000
+
+
+def declarations():
+    return [{'type':'function','function':{'name':spec.name,'description':spec.description,'parameters':spec.args.model_json_schema()}} for spec in REGISTRY.values()]
+
+
+class CallAccumulator:
+    def __init__(self): self.calls={}
+
+    def feed(self, delta):
+        values=delta.get('tool_calls',[])
+        if not isinstance(values,list): raise ToolError('Invalid streamed tool calls.')
+        for item in values:
+            if not isinstance(item,dict): raise ToolError('Invalid streamed tool call.')
+            index=item.get('index')
+            if type(index) is not int or not 0<=index<MAX_CALLS: raise ToolError('Too many or invalid tool calls.')
+            call=self.calls.setdefault(index,{'id':'','name':'','arguments':''})
+            identifier=item.get('id')
+            if identifier is not None:
+                if not isinstance(identifier,str) or len(identifier)>128 or (call['id'] and call['id']!=identifier): raise ToolError('Invalid tool call ID.')
+                call['id']=identifier
+            function=item.get('function',{})
+            if not isinstance(function,dict): raise ToolError('Invalid tool function.')
+            for key in ('name','arguments'):
+                chunk=function.get(key)
+                if chunk is not None:
+                    if not isinstance(chunk,str): raise ToolError('Invalid tool function fragment.')
+                    call[key]+=chunk
+                    if len(call[key].encode('utf-8'))>(128 if key=='name' else MAX_ARGUMENT_BYTES): raise ToolError('Tool call is too large.')
+
+    def finalize(self):
+        result=[];seen=set()
+        for index in sorted(self.calls):
+            call=self.calls[index];identifier=call['id'];name=call['name']
+            if not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{1,128}',identifier) or identifier in seen: raise ToolError('Invalid or duplicate tool call ID.')
+            if name not in REGISTRY: raise ToolError('Unknown tool.')
+            try:
+                args=json.loads(call['arguments'])
+                parsed=REGISTRY[name].args.model_validate(args).model_dump()
+            except (json.JSONDecodeError,ValidationError,TypeError) as exc:
+                raise ToolError('Invalid tool arguments.') from exc
+            seen.add(identifier);result.append({'id':identifier,'name':name,'arguments':parsed})
+        return result

+"""Audited tool execution for a live run, independent of the model adapter."""
+import asyncio
+import json
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from typing import Callable
+
+from . import tool_audit, tools
+
+
+@dataclass
+class ToolContext:
+    db: Callable
+    data_dir: object
+    run_id: str
+    bot_id: str
+    redact: Callable[[str], str]
+    allow: list[str]
+    deny: list[str]
+    notify: Callable[[dict], None]
+    # The broader approval is deliberately run-scoped, not permanent.
+    run_grants: set[str] = field(default_factory=set)
+
+
+def live(c, context):
+    row=c.execute('SELECT status,bot_id FROM runs WHERE id=?',(context.run_id,)).fetchone()
+    if not row or row['bot_id'] != context.bot_id or row['status'] not in ('running','waiting_approval'):
+        raise tools.ToolError('The Bot run is no longer active.')
+
+
+async def execute(context: ToolContext, name: str, args: dict, wait_decision):
+    """Propose, obtain permission, then execute the exact displayed arguments.
+
+    wait_decision is an async callback returning approve, approve_once, or deny.
+    Each write is surfaced in notify even when an earlier run-scoped grant is
+    used. The caller is responsible for forwarding notifications to the UI.
+    """
+    with context.db() as c:
+        c.execute('BEGIN IMMEDIATE');live(c,context)
+        call=tool_audit.propose(c,context.run_id,context.bot_id,name,args,context.redact)
+        row=dict(c.execute('SELECT * FROM tool_calls WHERE id=?',(call,)).fetchone())
+    try:
+        context.notify({'type':'tool.proposed','call_id':call,'tool':name,'risk':row['risk'],'arguments':json.loads(row['arguments']),'status':row['status']})
+        if row['status']=='pending':
+            granted=name in context.run_grants
+            decision='run_grant' if granted else await wait_decision(call)
+            with context.db() as c:
+                c.execute('BEGIN IMMEDIATE');live(c,context)
+                if granted:
+                    tool_audit.approve_from_run_grant(c,call);status='approved'
+                else:
+                    status=tool_audit.decide(c,call,decision)
+            if not granted and decision=='approve': context.run_grants.add(name)
+            context.notify({'type':'tool.decision','call_id':call,'decision':decision,'status':status})
+            if status=='denied': return {'status':'denied','message':'The owner denied this tool call.'}
+        with context.db() as c:
+            c.execute('BEGIN IMMEDIATE');live(c,context);row=tool_audit.claim(c,call)
+        safe_args=json.loads(row['arguments'])
+        try:
+            if name=='web_fetch': result=await tools.web_fetch(tools.WebFetchArgs.model_validate(safe_args),context.allow,context.deny)
+            elif name=='write_note': result=tools.write_note(context.data_dir,context.bot_id,tools.NotesArgs.model_validate(safe_args))
+            else: raise tools.ToolError('Unknown tool.')
+            success=True
+        except tools.ToolError as exc:
+            result={'error':str(exc)};success=False
+        with context.db() as c:
+            c.execute('BEGIN IMMEDIATE');tool_audit.finish(c,call,result,success,context.redact)
+            stored=json.loads(c.execute('SELECT result FROM tool_calls WHERE id=?',(call,)).fetchone()['result'])
+        context.notify({'type':'tool.finished','call_id':call,'status':'completed' if success else 'failed','result':stored})
+        return {'status':'completed' if success else 'failed','result':stored}
+    except (asyncio.CancelledError, Exception):
+        # A call in progress is never automatically replayed after interruption.
+        with context.db() as c:
+            c.execute('BEGIN IMMEDIATE')
+            tool_audit.abort(c,call,'Interrupted; outcome may be unknown.',context.redact)
+        raise

+"""Typed tool primitives. Calling a write tool still requires an approval layer.
+
+Web requests connect to a validated DNS result directly, not via a proxy or a
+second DNS lookup. Redirects and compressed responses are intentionally not
+followed/decoded, keeping the public-network and size boundaries explicit.
+"""
+import asyncio
+import ipaddress
+import os
+import re
+import socket
+import ssl
+import uuid
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Literal
+from urllib.parse import quote, urlsplit
+
+import h11
+from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field
+
+MAX_FETCH_BYTES = 256 * 1024
+FETCH_TIMEOUT = 10
+
+
+class ToolError(ValueError):
+    pass
+
+
+class WebFetchArgs(BaseModel):
+    model_config = ConfigDict(extra='forbid')
+    url: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=2048)
+
+
+class NotesArgs(BaseModel):
+    model_config = ConfigDict(extra='forbid')
+    filename: str = Field(min_length=5, max_length=85)
+    content: str = Field(max_length=16000)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class ToolSpec:
+    name: str
+    risk: Literal['read', 'write', 'send', 'spend']
+    args: type[BaseModel]
+    description: str
+
+
+REGISTRY = {
+    'web_fetch': ToolSpec('web_fetch', 'read', WebFetchArgs, 'Fetch text from an explicitly allowed public website.'),
+    'write_note': ToolSpec('write_note', 'write', NotesArgs, 'Create a text note in this Bot’s workspace.'),
+}
+
+
+def canonical_host(host):
+    try:
+        value = host.rstrip('.').encode('idna').decode('ascii').lower()
+        if not value or len(value) > 253:
+            raise ValueError()
+        return value
+    except (UnicodeError, ValueError) as exc:
+        raise ToolError('Invalid hostname.') from exc
+
+
+def host_matches(host, pattern):
+    suffix = pattern.startswith('.')
+    domain = canonical_host(pattern[1:] if suffix else pattern)
+    return host == domain or (suffix and host.endswith('.' + domain))
+
+
+def validate_target(url, allow, deny):
+    if any(ord(ch) < 33 or ord(ch) == 127 for ch in url):
+        raise ToolError('URL contains invalid characters.')
+    try:
+        parsed = urlsplit(url)
+        if parsed.scheme not in ('http', 'https') or not parsed.hostname or parsed.username is not None or parsed.password is not None:
+            raise ToolError('Use an HTTP(S) URL without credentials.')
+        host, port = canonical_host(parsed.hostname), parsed.port or (443 if parsed.scheme == 'https' else 80)
+        if not 1 <= port <= 65535:
+            raise ToolError('Invalid port.')
+    except ValueError as exc:
+        raise ToolError('Invalid URL.') from exc
+    if host == 'localhost' or host.endswith('.localhost') or host.endswith('.local'):
+        raise ToolError('Private and non-public addresses are blocked.')
+    try:
+        address = ipaddress.ip_address(host)
+        if not public_address(address): raise ToolError('Private and non-public addresses are blocked.')
+    except ValueError as exc:
+        if isinstance(exc, ToolError): raise
+    if any(host_matches(host, item) for item in deny) or not any(host_matches(host, item) for item in allow):
+        raise ToolError('This website is not allowed by the web fetch policy.')
+    path = quote(parsed.path or '/', safe="/%:@!$&'()*+,;=-._~")
+    if parsed.query: path += '?' + quote(parsed.query, safe="/%:@!$&'()*+,;=?-._~")
+    return parsed.scheme, host, port, path
+
+
+def public_address(address):
+    if isinstance(address, ipaddress.IPv6Address) and address.ipv4_mapped:
+        address = address.ipv4_mapped
+    return address.is_global and not (address.is_multicast or address.is_unspecified or address.is_loopback or address.is_link_local or address.is_private or address.is_reserved)
+
+
+async def _fetch(url, allow, deny):
+    scheme, host, port, path = validate_target(url, allow, deny)
+    loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
+    try:
+        resolved = await loop.getaddrinfo(host, port, family=socket.AF_UNSPEC, type=socket.SOCK_STREAM)
+    except OSError as exc:
+        raise ToolError('Could not resolve this website.') from exc
+    addresses = list(dict.fromkeys(item[4][0] for item in resolved))
+    if not addresses:
+        raise ToolError('Could not resolve this website.')
+    try:
+        if any(not public_address(ipaddress.ip_address(address)) for address in addresses):
+            raise ToolError('Private and non-public addresses are blocked.')
+    except ValueError as exc:
+        if isinstance(exc, ToolError): raise
+        raise ToolError('Could not validate website addresses.') from exc
+    # Pass a literal validated address to the socket; never re-resolve a host
+    # after checking it. TLS certificate validation still uses the original host.
+    tls = ssl.create_default_context() if scheme == 'https' else None
+    try:
+        reader, writer = await asyncio.open_connection(addresses[0],port,ssl=tls,server_hostname=host if tls else None)
+        try:
+            conn=h11.Connection(h11.CLIENT, max_incomplete_event_size=16*1024)
+            authority=f'[{host}]' if ':' in host else host
+            if port != (443 if scheme=='https' else 80): authority += f':{port}'
+            writer.write(conn.send(h11.Request(method='GET',target=path,headers=[('Host',authority),('User-Agent','FunkBot/1.0'),('Accept','text/plain,text/html,application/json;q=0.9,*/*;q=0.1'),('Accept-Encoding','identity'),('Connection','close')])))
+            writer.write(conn.send(h11.EndOfMessage()))
+            await writer.drain()
+            body=bytearray(); status=None; content_type=''; encoding=''
+            while True:
+                event=conn.next_event()
+                if event is h11.NEED_DATA:
+                    data=await reader.read(8192)
+                    conn.receive_data(data)
+                    continue
+                if isinstance(event,h11.InformationalResponse): continue
+                if isinstance(event,h11.Response):
+                    status=event.status_code
+                    headers={k.decode('ascii').lower():v.decode('latin1') for k,v in event.headers}
+                    content_type=headers.get('content-type','')
+                    encoding=headers.get('content-encoding','').strip().lower()
+                    if status < 200 or status >= 300:
+                        raise ToolError('Website returned a non-success status; redirects are not followed.')
+                    if encoding not in ('','identity'):
+                        raise ToolError('Compressed responses are not supported.')
+                    try:
+                        if int(headers.get('content-length','0')) > MAX_FETCH_BYTES:
+                            raise ToolError('Website response is too large.')
+                    except ValueError as exc:
+                        if isinstance(exc,ToolError): raise
+                        raise ToolError('Invalid response length.') from exc
+                elif isinstance(event,h11.Data):
+                    body.extend(event.data)
+                    if len(body)>MAX_FETCH_BYTES: raise ToolError('Website response is too large.')
+                elif isinstance(event,h11.EndOfMessage):
+                    if status is None: raise ToolError('Website returned an invalid response.')
+                    return {'url':url,'status':status,'content_type':content_type[:200],'text':body.decode('utf-8','replace')}
+                elif isinstance(event,h11.ConnectionClosed):
+                    raise ToolError('Website closed the connection unexpectedly.')
+        finally:
+            writer.close()
+            try: await asyncio.wait_for(writer.wait_closed(), timeout=1)
+            except (OSError, asyncio.TimeoutError): pass
+    except (OSError, h11.RemoteProtocolError, h11.LocalProtocolError, UnicodeError) as exc:
+        raise ToolError('Could not safely fetch this website.') from exc
+
+
+async def web_fetch(args: WebFetchArgs, allow: list[str], deny: list[str]):
+    try:
+        return await asyncio.wait_for(_fetch(args.url,allow,deny), timeout=FETCH_TIMEOUT)
+    except asyncio.TimeoutError as exc:
+        raise ToolError('Website request timed out.') from exc
+
+
+def write_note(data_dir: Path, bot_id: str, args: NotesArgs):
+    """Create only a new file, through non-symlink directory descriptors."""
+    try:
+        if str(uuid.UUID(bot_id)) != bot_id: raise ValueError()
+    except ValueError as exc:
+        raise ToolError('Invalid Bot workspace.') from exc
+    if not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,79}\.txt',args.filename):
+        raise ToolError('Use a simple .txt filename without folders.')
+    if not hasattr(os, 'O_NOFOLLOW') or not hasattr(os, 'O_DIRECTORY') or os.open not in os.supports_dir_fd:
+        raise ToolError('Secure workspace writes are not supported on this platform; use Docker.')
+    flags=os.O_RDONLY|os.O_DIRECTORY|os.O_NOFOLLOW
+    root_fd=workspace_fd=bot_fd=None
+    try:
+        root_fd=os.open(data_dir,flags)
+        try: os.mkdir('workspaces',0o700,dir_fd=root_fd)
+        except FileExistsError: pass
+        workspace_fd=os.open('workspaces',flags,dir_fd=root_fd)
+        try: os.mkdir(bot_id,0o700,dir_fd=workspace_fd)
+        except FileExistsError: pass
+        bot_fd=os.open(bot_id,flags,dir_fd=workspace_fd)
+        fd=os.open(args.filename,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_NOFOLLOW,0o600,dir_fd=bot_fd)
+        with os.fdopen(fd,'w',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n') as file:
+            file.write(args.content)
+        return {'filename':args.filename,'bytes':len(args.content.encode('utf-8'))}
+    except FileExistsError as exc:
+        raise ToolError('That note already exists; choose another filename.') from exc
+    except OSError as exc:
+        raise ToolError('Could not safely create the note in this workspace.') from exc
+    finally:
+        for fd in (bot_fd,workspace_fd,root_fd):
+            if fd is not None: os.close(fd)

+import asyncio

+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_decision_cannot_be_submitted_twice_or_after_completion():

+    with pytest.raises(ToolError): broker.submit('one','deny')
+    assert await broker.wait('one')=='approve_once'
+    with pytest.raises(ToolError): broker.submit('one','approve')

+    with pytest.raises(asyncio.CancelledError): await task
+    with pytest.raises(ToolError): broker.submit('one','approve')

+def answer(usage=True):
+    parts=['data: '+json.dumps({'choices':[{'delta':{'content':'The real answer.'}}]})]

+import time

+def price(profile='smart', prompt='1', completion='2', max_prompt=1000, max_completion=500):
+    with service.db() as c:
+        c.execute('INSERT INTO budget_prices VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)', (profile,prompt,completion,max_prompt,max_completion))

+def reservation(run, bot='one', now=None):
+    with service.db() as c:
+        c.execute('BEGIN IMMEDIATE')

+def test_decimal_prices_and_utc_boundaries():
+    assert token_cost_nanos(1,2,'0.1','0.2') == 500
+    assert dollars_to_nanos('0.0000000001') == 1
+    assert limit_to_nanos('0.0000000001') == 0
+    for value in ('NaN','Infinity','-1','1000001'):
+        with pytest.raises(BudgetError): dollars_to_nanos(value)
+    for usage in [(-1,0),(None,1),(True,1)]:
+        with pytest.raises(BudgetError): token_cost_nanos(*usage,'1','1')
+    day,month = period_starts(datetime(2026,11,14,23,30,tzinfo=timezone.utc).timestamp())
+    assert datetime.fromtimestamp(day,timezone.utc).isoformat() == '2026-11-14T00:00:00+00:00'
+    assert datetime.fromtimestamp(month,timezone.utc).isoformat() == '2026-11-01T00:00:00+00:00'

+    with service.db() as c:
+        c.execute("UPDATE budget_limits SET monthly_nanos=NULL WHERE scope='account'")
+        c.execute("INSERT INTO budget_limits VALUES ('bot:one',1000000,NULL)")

+import json
+import time
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+import pytest
+import app as service
+from test_app import FakeClient, FakeStream, setup, configure_budget
+
+
+def tool_reply(name='write_note',args=None,usage=True,done=True):
+    if args is None: args={'filename':'approved.txt','content':'a safe note'}
+    lines=['data: '+json.dumps({'choices':[{'delta':{'tool_calls':[{'index':0,'id':'model_call_1','function':{'name':name,'arguments':json.dumps(args)}}]},'finish_reason':None}]}),
+           'data: '+json.dumps({'choices':[{'delta':{},'finish_reason':'tool_calls'}]})]
+    if usage: lines.append('data: '+json.dumps({'choices':[],'usage':{'prompt_tokens':200,'completion_tokens':50}}))
+    if done: lines.append('data: [DONE]')
+    return FakeStream(200,lines)
+
+
+def final_reply():
+    return FakeStream(200,['data: '+json.dumps({'choices':[{'delta':{'content':'All done.'}}]}),
+                           'data: '+json.dumps({'choices':[],'usage':{'prompt_tokens':300,'completion_tokens':40}}),'data: [DONE]'])
+
+
+def until_calls(client, run):
+    deadline=time.monotonic()+5
+    while time.monotonic()<deadline:
+        calls=client.get(f'/api/jobs/{run}/tool-calls').json()
+        if calls: return calls
+        time.sleep(.01)
+    pytest.fail('Tool call did not arrive')
+
+
+def get_events(client, run):
+    return [json.loads(line[6:]) for line in client.get(f'/api/jobs/{run}/events').text.splitlines() if line.startswith('data: ')]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('decision,exists',[('approve_once',True),('deny',False),('approve',True)])
+def test_streamed_tool_approval_and_accounted_followup(monkeypatch,decision,exists):
+    captured=[]
+    class Client(FakeClient):
+        def stream(self,*args,**kwargs):
+            captured.append(kwargs['json'])
+            return super().stream(*args,**kwargs)
+    FakeClient.responses=[tool_reply(),final_reply()]
+    monkeypatch.setattr(service.httpx,'AsyncClient',Client)
+    with TestClient(service.app) as c:
+        setup(c);configure_budget(c)
+        bot=c.post('/api/bots',json={'name':'Scout'}).json()['id']
+        run=c.post(f'/api/bots/{bot}/chat',json={'content':'Save a note'}).json()['job_id']
+        call=until_calls(c,run)[0]
+        assert call['status']=='pending'
+        assert c.get(f'/api/bots/{bot}/latest-run').json()['status']=='waiting_approval'
+        assert len(captured)==1
+        assert c.post(f'/api/jobs/{run}/tool-calls/{call["id"]}/decision',json={'decision':decision}).status_code==200
+        events=get_events(c,run)
+        assert events[-1]['type']=='done'
+        assert any(e['type']=='tool.proposed' and e['needs_decision'] for e in events)
+        assert any(e['type']=='tool.decision' and e['decision']==decision for e in events)
+        assert (service.DATA/'workspaces'/bot/'approved.txt').exists()==exists
+        assert len(captured)==2 and len(captured[0]['tools'])==2
+        assert captured[1]['messages'][-1]['role']=='tool'
+        assert json.loads(captured[1]['messages'][-1]['content'])['status']==('completed' if exists else 'denied')
+        assert c.get(f'/api/bots/{bot}/messages').json()[-1]['content']=='All done.'
+        with service.db() as db:
+            rounds=db.execute('SELECT status,actual_nanos FROM budget_reservations WHERE parent_run_id=? ORDER BY created_at',(run,)).fetchall()
+            assert [(r['status'],r['actual_nanos']) for r in rounds]==[('settled',300000),('settled',380000)]
+            assert db.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM usage').fetchone()[0]==2
+

+def test_stopping_pending_approval_leaves_no_note_and_no_unknown_charge(monkeypatch):

+import json
+from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
+import pytest
+import app as service
+from funkbot.tool_audit import propose, decide, claim, finish
+from funkbot.tools import ToolError

+def test_read_tool_is_auto_approved_and_every_transition_is_audited():
+    with service.db() as c:
+        call=propose(c,'run','bot','web_fetch',{'url':'https://example.com'},lambda value:value,now=1)
+        row=claim(c,call,now=2)
+        assert row['risk']=='read' and row['status']=='running'
+        finish(c,call,{'text':'actual secret result'},True,lambda value:value.replace('secret','[redacted]'),now=3)
+        assert [row['action'] for row in c.execute('SELECT action FROM tool_audit WHERE call_id=? ORDER BY id',(call,))] == ['proposed','read_auto_approved','started','completed']
+        assert json.loads(c.execute('SELECT result FROM tool_calls WHERE id=?',(call,)).fetchone()['result'])=={'text':'actual [redacted] result'}
+
+
+def test_write_requires_approval_and_cannot_be_approved_or_executed_twice():
+    with service.db() as c:
+        call=propose(c,'run','bot','write_note',{'filename':'file.txt','content':'secret is here'},lambda value:value.replace('secret','[redacted]'))
+        assert '[redacted]' in c.execute('SELECT arguments FROM tool_calls WHERE id=?',(call,)).fetchone()['arguments']
+        with pytest.raises(ToolError,match='not approved'): claim(c,call)
+        assert decide(c,call,'approve_once')=='approved'
+        with pytest.raises(ToolError,match='no longer pending'): decide(c,call,'approve')
+        row=claim(c,call);assert json.loads(row['arguments'])['content']=='[redacted] is here'
+        with pytest.raises(ToolError,match='already started'): claim(c,call)
+        finish(c,call,{'filename':'file.txt'},True,lambda value:value)
+        assert [r['action'] for r in c.execute('SELECT action FROM tool_audit WHERE call_id=? ORDER BY id',(call,))]==['proposed','approve_once','started','completed']
+
+
+def test_deny_is_terminal_and_unknown_tools_and_arguments_are_rejected():
+    with service.db() as c:
+        with pytest.raises(ToolError,match='Unknown'): propose(c,'r','b','shell',{'command':'echo hi'},lambda x:x)
+        with pytest.raises(ToolError,match='arguments'): propose(c,'r','b','write_note',{'filename':'a.txt','content':'x','other':1},lambda x:x)
+        call=propose(c,'r','b','write_note',{'filename':'a.txt','content':'x'},lambda x:x)
+        assert decide(c,call,'deny')=='denied'
+        with pytest.raises(ToolError): claim(c,call)
+        with pytest.raises(ToolError): decide(c,call,'approve')
+
+
+def test_concurrent_claim_only_one_can_execute():
+    with service.db() as c:
+        call=propose(c,'r','b','write_note',{'filename':'a.txt','content':'x'},lambda x:x)
+        decide(c,call,'approve')
+    def attempt(_):
+        with service.db() as c:
+            c.execute('BEGIN IMMEDIATE')
+            try: claim(c,call);return True
+            except ToolError: return False
+    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:
+        assert sorted(pool.map(attempt,range(2))) == [False,True]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('risk,decision',[('send','deny'),('spend','approve_once')])
+def test_future_send_and_spend_categories_require_approval(monkeypatch,risk,decision):
+    from funkbot.tools import REGISTRY,ToolSpec,NotesArgs
+    monkeypatch.setitem(REGISTRY,'test_'+risk,ToolSpec('test_'+risk,risk,NotesArgs,'Test only; not executable.'))
+    with service.db() as c:
+        call=propose(c,'r','b','test_'+risk,{'filename':'file.txt','content':'hello'},lambda x:x)
+        assert c.execute('SELECT status FROM tool_calls WHERE id=?',(call,)).fetchone()['status']=='pending'
+        with pytest.raises(ToolError): claim(c,call)
+        assert decide(c,call,decision)==('denied' if decision=='deny' else 'approved')

+import asyncio
+import pytest
+from funkbot.tool_bridge import ToolBridge
+from funkbot.tools import ToolError
+from test_tool_runtime import make_context
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_live_approval_card_can_be_answered_immediately_and_is_audited(tmp_path):
+    ctx,_=make_context(tmp_path);events=[];holder={}
+    def emit(event):
+        events.append(event)
+        if event['type']=='tool.proposed': holder['bridge'].submit(event['call_id'],'approve_once')
+    bridge=ToolBridge(ctx,emit);holder['bridge']=bridge
+    result=await bridge.execute('write_note',{'filename':'ok.txt','content':'safe'})
+    assert result['status']=='completed' and (tmp_path/'workspaces'/ctx.bot_id/'ok.txt').read_text()=='safe'
+    assert [e['type'] for e in events]==['tool.proposed','tool.decision','tool.finished']
+    with pytest.raises(ToolError): bridge.submit(events[0]['call_id'],'approve')
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_run_grant_never_leaves_an_unanswered_waiter(tmp_path):
+    ctx,_=make_context(tmp_path);events=[];holder={}
+    def emit(event):
+        events.append(event)
+        if event['type']=='tool.proposed' and not ctx.run_grants: holder['bridge'].submit(event['call_id'],'approve')
+    bridge=ToolBridge(ctx,emit);holder['bridge']=bridge
+    await bridge.execute('write_note',{'filename':'first.txt','content':'one'})
+    await bridge.execute('write_note',{'filename':'second.txt','content':'two'})

+import pytest
+from funkbot.tool_protocol import CallAccumulator, declarations
+from funkbot.tools import ToolError
+
+
+def test_declarations_expose_only_the_two_typed_tools():
+    items=declarations()
+    assert [item['function']['name'] for item in items]==['web_fetch','write_note']
+    assert all(item['function']['parameters']['additionalProperties'] is False for item in items)
+
+
+def test_fragmented_calls_reconstruct_in_index_order():
+    stream=CallAccumulator()
+    stream.feed({'tool_calls':[{'index':1,'id':'call_b','function':{'name':'write_','arguments':'{"filename":"x.txt",'}},{'index':0,'id':'call_a','function':{'name':'web_fetch','arguments':'{"url":"https://example.com"}'}}]})
+    stream.feed({'tool_calls':[{'index':1,'function':{'name':'note','arguments':'"content":"hello"}'}}]})
+    assert stream.finalize()==[{'id':'call_a','name':'web_fetch','arguments':{'url':'https://example.com'}},{'id':'call_b','name':'write_note','arguments':{'filename':'x.txt','content':'hello'}}]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('parts',[
+    [{'index':0,'id':'a','function':{'name':'shell','arguments':'{}'}}],
+    [{'index':7,'id':'a','function':{'name':'web_fetch','arguments':'{}'}}],
+    [{'index':0,'id':'a','function':{'name':'web_fetch','arguments':'{'}}],
+    [{'index':0,'id':'a','function':{'name':'web_fetch','arguments':'{"url":"x","shell":"bad"}'}}],
+    [{'index':0,'id':'a','function':{'name':'web_fetch','arguments':'{"url":"x"}'}},{'index':1,'id':'a','function':{'name':'web_fetch','arguments':'{"url":"y"}'}}],
+    [{'index':0,'id':'bad id','function':{'name':'web_fetch','arguments':'{"url":"x"}'}}],
+    [{'index':0,'id':'a','function':{'name':'web_fetch','arguments':'x'*20001}}],
+])
+def test_invalid_streams_fail_closed(parts):
+    stream=CallAccumulator()
+    with pytest.raises(ToolError):
+        stream.feed({'tool_calls':parts});stream.finalize()

+import asyncio

+def make_context(tmp_path):
+    bot_id=str(uuid.uuid4());run_id=str(uuid.uuid4());events=[]
+    with service.db() as c:
+        c.execute('INSERT INTO bots VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',(bot_id,'Bot','Editor','instructions','mint','round','smart',1))
+        c.execute('INSERT INTO runs VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)',(run_id,bot_id,'running',1,1))
+    ctx=ToolContext(service.db,tmp_path,run_id,bot_id,lambda text:text.replace('secret','[redacted]'),['example.com'],[],events.append)
+    return ctx,events

+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_deny_and_approve_once_never_create_unapproved_notes(tmp_path):

+    assert result['status']=='denied' and not (tmp_path/'workspaces'/ctx.bot_id/'denied.txt').exists()
+    async def once(call): decisions.append(call);return 'approve_once'
+    result=await execute(ctx,'write_note',{'filename':'one.txt','content':'my secret'},once)
+    assert result['status']=='completed' and (tmp_path/'workspaces'/ctx.bot_id/'one.txt').read_text()=='my [redacted]'
+    result=await execute(ctx,'write_note',{'filename':'two.txt','content':'two'},once)
+    assert result['status']=='completed' and len(decisions)==3
+    assert len([e for e in events if e['type']=='tool.proposed'])==3
+    with service.db() as c:
+        assert c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tool_audit WHERE action='approve_once'").fetchone()[0]==2
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_approve_is_run_scoped_and_every_call_is_surfaced_and_audited(tmp_path):
+    ctx,events=make_context(tmp_path);decisions=[]
+    async def grant(call): decisions.append(call);return 'approve'
+    await execute(ctx,'write_note',{'filename':'one.txt','content':'one'},grant)
+    await execute(ctx,'write_note',{'filename':'two.txt','content':'two'},grant)
+    assert len(decisions)==1
+    assert [e['decision'] for e in events if e['type']=='tool.decision']==['approve','run_grant']
+    with service.db() as c:
+        assert c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tool_audit WHERE action='run_grant'").fetchone()[0]==1
+    other,other_events=make_context(tmp_path)
+    await execute(other,'write_note',{'filename':'other.txt','content':'other'},grant)
+    assert len(decisions)==2 and other_events[1]['decision']=='approve'
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_read_only_runs_automatically_but_enforces_web_policy(tmp_path):
+    ctx,events=make_context(tmp_path);ctx.allow.append('127.0.0.1')

+import asyncio
+import os

+import pytest

+from funkbot import tools
+
+
+def test_registry_is_typed_and_has_no_shell():
+    assert set(tools.REGISTRY)=={'web_fetch','write_note'}
+    assert tools.REGISTRY['web_fetch'].risk=='read'
+    assert tools.REGISTRY['write_note'].risk=='write'
+    with pytest.raises(ValidationError): tools.WebFetchArgs(url='https://example.com',extra='not allowed')
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('url',[
+    'http://127.0.0.1/', 'http://localhost/', 'http://10.2.3.4/', 'http://169.254.169.254/',
+    'http://[::1]/', 'http://[::ffff:127.0.0.1]/', 'http://192.168.1.1/', 'http://100.64.0.1/',
+    'http://224.0.0.1/', 'http://user:pass@example.com/', 'file:///etc/passwd',
+])
+def test_rejects_private_addresses_and_disallowed_urls(url):
+    with pytest.raises(tools.ToolError): tools.validate_target(url,['127.0.0.1','localhost','10.2.3.4','169.254.169.254','::1','::ffff:127.0.0.1','192.168.1.1','100.64.0.1','224.0.0.1','example.com'],[])
+
+
+def test_allowlist_default_deny_and_denylist_precedence():
+    assert tools.validate_target('https://www.example.com/a?x=1',['.example.com'],[])[1:] == ('www.example.com',443,'/a?x=1')
+    for allow,deny,url in [([],[],'https://example.com'),(['example.com'],[],'https://sub.example.com'),(['.example.com'],['private.example.com'],'https://private.example.com'),(['.example.com'],[],'https://evil-example.com')]:
+        with pytest.raises(tools.ToolError): tools.validate_target(url,allow,deny)
+

+class Writer:
+    def __init__(self): self.data=b''
+    def write(self, value): self.data += value
+    async def drain(self): pass
+    def close(self): pass
+    async def wait_closed(self): pass
+

+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_dns_mixed_private_results_are_blocked_before_connect(monkeypatch):
+    loop=asyncio.get_running_loop()
+    async def resolve(*args,**kwargs):
+        return [(socket.AF_INET,socket.SOCK_STREAM,6,'',('93.184.216.34',443)),(socket.AF_INET,socket.SOCK_STREAM,6,'',('127.0.0.1',443))]
+    async def connect(*args,**kwargs): pytest.fail('must not connect to mixed public/private DNS')
+    monkeypatch.setattr(loop,'getaddrinfo',resolve);monkeypatch.setattr(asyncio,'open_connection',connect)
+    with pytest.raises(tools.ToolError,match='Private'): await tools.web_fetch(tools.WebFetchArgs(url='https://example.com'),['example.com'],[])
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_fetch_pins_validated_ip_and_tls_hostname(monkeypatch):
+    loop=asyncio.get_running_loop();calls=[];writer=Writer()
+    async def resolve(*args,**kwargs): return [(socket.AF_INET,socket.SOCK_STREAM,6,'',('93.184.216.34',443))]
+    async def connect(ip,port,**kwargs):
+        calls.append((ip,port,kwargs));reader=asyncio.StreamReader();reader.feed_data(b'HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Length: 5\r\nContent-Type: text/plain\r\n\r\nhello');reader.feed_eof();return reader,writer
+    monkeypatch.setattr(loop,'getaddrinfo',resolve);monkeypatch.setattr(asyncio,'open_connection',connect)
+    result=await tools.web_fetch(tools.WebFetchArgs(url='https://example.com/hello'),['example.com'],[])
+    assert result['text']=='hello' and result['status']==200
+    assert calls[0][0]=='93.184.216.34' and calls[0][2]['server_hostname']=='example.com'
+    assert b'Host: example.com' in writer.data
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('response,reason',[
+    (b'HTTP/1.1 302 Found\r\nLocation: http://127.0.0.1/\r\nContent-Length: 0\r\n\r\n','redirects'),
+    (b'HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Length: 262145\r\n\r\n','too large'),
+    (b'HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Encoding: gzip\r\nContent-Length: 0\r\n\r\n','Compressed'),

+async def test_fetch_refuses_redirects_oversized_or_compressed_responses(monkeypatch,response,reason):

+def test_notes_are_isolated_create_only_and_reject_symlinks(tmp_path):

+'use client';

+export type ToolCall={id:string;tool_name:string;risk:string;arguments:Record<string,unknown>;status:string;result:unknown;created_at:number;audit:{action:string;created_at:number}[]};
+type Decision='approve'|'approve_once'|'deny';

+export default function ToolActivity({calls,jobId,pendingId,onDecision}:{calls:ToolCall[];jobId:string;pendingId:string;onDecision:(call:string,decision:Decision)=>Promise<void>}){

+  const pending=!!jobId&&call.id===pendingId&&call.status==='pending';
+  return <article className={`tool-card ${pending?'tool-card-pending':''}`} key={call.id}><div className="tool-card-head"><div><strong>{call.tool_name==='write_note'?'Create workspace note':call.tool_name==='web_fetch'?'Fetch a web page':call.tool_name}</strong><span>{call.risk==='read'?'Read-only · automatic':`${call.risk[0].toUpperCase()+call.risk.slice(1)} · approval required`}</span></div><span className="tool-status">{pending?'Needs your approval':call.status}</span></div><dl>{Object.entries(call.arguments).map(([key,value])=><div key={key}><dt>{key}</dt><dd><pre>{typeof value==='string'?value:JSON.stringify(value,null,2)}</pre></dd></div>)}</dl>{pending&&<><p className="tool-help">Review the exact content above. +'use client';
+import {useEffect,useState} from 'react';
+
+type Policy={allow:string[];deny:string[]};
+async function request(init?:RequestInit):Promise<Policy>{
+ const res=await fetch('/api/settings/web-policy',init),body=await res.json();
+ if(!res.ok)throw Error(typeof body.detail==='string'?body.detail:'Enter valid hostnames without paths or ports.');
+ return body;
+}
+export default function WebPolicySettings(){
+ const [allow,setAllow]=useState(''),[deny,setDeny]=useState(''),[loaded,setLoaded]=useState(false),[busy,setBusy]=useState(false),[error,setError]=useState(''),[notice,setNotice]=useState('');
+ useEffect(()=>{let active=true;request().then(p=>{if(active){setAllow(p.allow.join('\n'));setDeny(p.deny.join('\n'));setLoaded(true)}}).catch(e=>{if(active)setError(e.message)});return()=>{active=false}},[]);
+ async function save(e:React.FormEvent){e.preventDefault();setBusy(true);setError('');setNotice('');try{const lines=(value:string)=>value.split(/\r?\n/).map(v=>v.trim()).filter(Boolean);const p=await request({method:'PUT',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({allow:lines(allow),deny:lines(deny)})});setAllow(p.allow.join('\n'));setDeny(p.deny.join('\n'));setNotice('Web policy saved.')}catch(e){setError((e as Error).message)}finally{setBusy(false)}}
+ return <div className="settings-body web-policy"><h3>Web access policy</h3><p className="field-hint">Web fetch is read-only and blocked by default. Add one exact hostname per line, or use a leading dot to include a domain and its subdomains (for example, .example.com). Denied hosts always take precedence.</p><p className="field-hint">Private and loopback addresses are blocked even if a domain resolves to them. Redirects are not followed; responses have size and time limits.</p>{error&&<p className="error" role="alert">{error}</p>}{notice&&<p className="notice" role="status">{notice}</p>}{loaded?<form onSubmit={save}><label htmlFor="web-allow">Allowed hosts</label><textarea id="web-allow" rows={5} value={allow} onChange={e=>setAllow(e.target.value)} placeholder="example.com"/><label htmlFor="web-deny">Denied hosts</label><textarea id="web-deny" rows={5} value={deny} onChange={e=>setDeny(e.target.value)} placeholder="private.example.com"/><button className="primary" disabled={busy}>{busy?'Saving…':'Save web policy'}</button></form>:!error&&<p>Loading web policy…</p>}</div>

+// Only use against a fresh disposable installation: creates and deletes Bots.

+// Disposable deterministic OpenAI-compatible gateway for tool E2E tests only.
+import http from 'node:http';
+const port=Number(process.env.MOCK_PORT||8030);
+http.createServer(async(req,res)=>{
+ if(req.method!=='POST'||req.url!=='/v1/chat/completions'){res.writeHead(404).end();return}
+ let raw='';for await(const data of req)raw+=data;const payload=JSON.parse(raw);
+ const lastUser=payload.messages.filter(m=>m.role==='user').at(-1)?.content||'';
+ const hasTool=payload.messages.at(-1)?.role==='tool';
+ const chunks=[];
+ if(!hasTool){
+  const isFetch=lastUser.includes('fetch loopback');
+  const args=isFetch?{url:'http://127.0.0.1:8030/private'}:{filename:lastUser.includes('deny')?'denied.txt':'approved.txt',content:'A real approved fixture note.'};
+  chunks.push({choices:[{delta:{tool_calls:[{index:0,id:'fixture-call',function:{name:isFetch?'web_fetch':'write_note',arguments:JSON.stringify(args)}}]},finish_reason:null}]});
+  chunks.push({choices:[{delta:{},finish_reason:'tool_calls'}]});
+ }else chunks.push({choices:[{delta:{content:'Fixture response after the tool result.'},finish_reason:'stop'}]});
+ chunks.push({choices:[],usage:{prompt_tokens:200,completion_tokens:50}});
+ res.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':'text/event-stream'});for(const chunk of chunks)res.write('data: '+JSON.stringify(chunk)+'\n\n');res.end('data: [DONE]\n\n');
+}).listen(port,'0.0.0.0',()=>console.log(`Disposable mock gateway listening on ${port}`));
